name: GL_FRC_USER_ACCESS_REPORTS
description: This table contains the list of reports from BI catalog that a user has access. This includes all the 3 types of reports namely BIP, OTBI and Financial Report.

columns.name: USER_ACCESS_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for each report that user has access.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: The latest principal username of the user.

columns.name: REPORT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of the report. Valid Values are BIP, Dashboard, Analysis and FR.

columns.name: LAST_ACCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Holds the date on which the report is last accessed by the user from reporting center user interface.

columns.name: LAST_ACCESSED_BIP_ESS_REQ_ID
columns.description: Holds the ESS job request id which is last accessed by the user from reporting center user interface.

columns.name: BIP_REPORT_JOB_DEFINITION
columns.description: Holds the ESS Job definition of a BIP report. This column will be populated only if the report type is BIP.

columns.name: FAVORITE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to show whether a report is favorite for the given user. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to show whether a report is deleted from the catalog for the given user. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: LATEST_REQUEST_EXISTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to show whether a new ESS request exists for a BIP report for the logged in user. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: PERMISSION_CODE
columns.description: Permission code for report. The value in this column indicates the permission types ex - READ, TRAVERSE, DELETE, WRITE etc.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
